mapper.select: SELECT r.*, o.order_number AS orderNumber, wh.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, ow.owner_name AS ownerName, p.product_code AS productCode, p.product_name AS productName, u.realname AS operatorName FROM wms_tasks_records r LEFT JOIN wms_stock_in_orders o ON r.stock_in_order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouses wh ON r.target_warehouse_id = wh.id LEFT JOIN wms_cargo_owners ow ON o.owner_id = ow.id LEFT JOIN wms_products p ON r.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.operator = u.id ${ew.customSqlSegment}
